Cats don't have to be fed or taken care of in any way. All they need to flourish is the pests which are attracted to our food. Sure, they're not going to eliminate all mice, but if there are lots of mice, cats will breed quickly and keep them in check. Cats are essentially zero maintenance guardians against all pests smaller than themselves. Dogs on the other hand help protect us against larger threats. They're both extremely useful in their own way. As to whether they're useful as modern companions, people like them and get attached to them and have warm fuzzy feelings about both, so I imagine they're working fine.
